_README: Every api/ handler that tools/preauth_oracle_check.py reports as having NO
AUTH BOUNDARY must appear here, declared, with a reason somebody can check.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The checker has always listed those handlers and its
own header has always said they must be READ rather than assumed public.
Nothing recorded the outcome of reading them, so the list was re-triaged from
scratch every time and a NEW one could be added with nothing to notice it.
That is not hypothetical: api/claude.js was an open Anthropic proxy whose own
comment said 'this endpoint has no other auth beyond a client-supplied
app_id'. The design was known. The consequence was not, until 2026-09-05.
'class' is what actually protects the endpoint, not what it is called:
public-by-design    anonymous callers are the point. Anti-abuse, if any, is
named in the reason.
bespoke-auth        a real credential the checker cannot see, because it is
not validateLicenseKey() or verifySessionToken().
webhook-signature   authenticated by the sender's signature over the body.
cron-secret         a shared secret in the Authorization header.
pilot-only          reachable without a credential, and that is a KNOWN
LIMIT with a stated precondition. Read 'precondition'
before assuming it still holds.
A declaration is not an endorsement. pilot-only entries are open questions
written down, which is the difference between a risk somebody chose and a
risk nobody noticed.

api/greeting.js.reason: Returns an opening line before anyone has typed anything; every SAIRN app calls it on load, before any licence exists. Zero Supabase writes -- verified by grep for method:'POST'/'PATCH'/'DELETE', which returns none. Read 2026-09-08.

api/bridge.js.reason: One Supabase write, to rest/v1/bridge_data, with no credential of any kind. NOT the cross-app data path most apps mean by 'bridge' -- its own header opens by warning about that name collision, and the real path is api/sd-data.js.
api/bridge.js.precondition: Nothing stops an anonymous caller writing bridge_data. Acceptable only while that table holds nothing a customer relies on. Read 2026-09-08 and recorded as an open row rather than fixed.

api/network.js.reason: Cross-tenant anonymised-pattern aggregation. One write to rest/v1/network_insights with no credential.
api/network.js.precondition: An anonymous caller can contribute to a cross-tenant aggregate, i.e. poison it. The data is anonymised so this is an integrity question, not a confidentiality one. Open row.

api/org-intel.js.reason: SAIRNscape organisation-intelligence backend. One write, no credential.

api/sd-agent.js.reason: FALSE POSITIVE in the checker, and the clearest example of why this file is per-endpoint rather than a blanket exemption. It DOES authenticate: sd-agent.js:214-215 reads the bearer, :228 calls store.validateAndGate(licenseKey). The checker only knows validateLicenseKey() and verifySessionToken() by name, exactly as its own header says. Its header also states the residual honestly: bearer licence is the only auth, so anyone holding the key can confirm a tool use.

api/stonedesk-public.js.reason: The public storefront. Its header states the model outright: the only thing identifying a shop is its public shop_slug, and it refuses a slug whose shop is not published (resolveShopSlug, :197). Writes are quote_request leads, which is the feature. Rate-limited.

api/agent/enqueue.js.reason: Queues an arbitrary operation and params to a named on-prem agent with NO credential. The only gates are that agent_id exists, its status is active, and its plan has not expired.
api/agent/enqueue.js.precondition: ITS OWN HEADER SETS THE CONDITION AND IT IS THE ONE TO CHECK: 'fine for a single-customer pilot where the agent_id isn't guessable/shared, but it must NOT be treated as secure multi-tenant isolation. Before more than one customer relies on this in parallel, add real per-customer auth.' Whether that precondition still holds is a question about the sairn_agents table, not about this file. Raised as its own open row 2026-09-08.

api/agent/poll.js.reason: Bearer AGENT token, read from the Authorization header and refused when absent. The credential is the agent's own, not a licence, so the checker cannot see it.

api/agent/register.js.reason: Same bearer agent-token shape as poll.js.

api/agent/result.js.reason: Same bearer agent-token shape as poll.js.

api/agent/stripe-webhook.js.reason: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET with a stripe-signature header. Authenticated by the signature over the raw body, which no bearer check could replace.

api/sairncash/checkout.js.reason: Creates a Stripe Checkout session for a prospect who by definition has no account yet. Holds STRIPE_SECRET_KEY server-side; the caller supplies nothing privileged.

api/sairncash/portal.js.reason: Stripe billing-portal link. Same pre-account position as checkout.js.

api/sairncash/firebase-config.js.reason: Serves the Firebase WEB config, which is public by Firebase's own design -- it identifies a project, it does not authorise. Kept server-side only to avoid hardcoding it in the client.

api/sairncash/stripe-webhook.js.reason: SAIRNCASH_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, verified with stripe.webhooks.constructEvent over the raw body.

api/sairncash/trial-renew.js.reason: Refuses unless the Authorization header equals 'Bearer ' + SAIRNCASH_ADMIN_SECRET, checked before anything else. Admin-approval-gated by design.

api/sairncash/trial-start.js.reason: Creates a 30-day trial for a prospect with no account. Michael's 2026-08-18 decision, recorded in the file: one trial per email is the only anti-abuse control in v1, accepted because renewal is admin-gated (trial-renew.js). Duplicate emails answer 409.

api/sairncash/trial-verify.js.reason: Re-verifies a trial against sairncash_trial by the caller's own trial_token. The token IS the credential; expiry is computed from the table's expires_at against the server clock, never from a client-supplied date.

api/sairncash/verify.js.reason: Verifies a Stripe sessionId or subscriptionId against Stripe itself. The identifier is the credential and it is checked upstream, not trusted.

api/sairncash/waitlist.js.reason: Pre-launch waitlist signup: an email address from an anonymous visitor is the whole feature. Inserts with resolution=ignore-duplicates. It exists because the previous handler faked success and discarded the email.

api/sairndental/public-availability.js.reason: Read-only appointment availability for a practice's public booking page. Zero writes -- verified by grep. Rate-limited.

api/sairndental/public-book.js.reason: A patient books an appointment without an account; that is the feature. Writes are the booking. Rate-limited, and the orphan-on-failure defect it once had is fixed and covered by its own suite.

api/sairndental/public-complaint-submit..reason: A patient submits a complaint anonymously. One write, rate-limited.

api/sairndental/public-complaint-thread..reason: Reads one complaint thread by its own token: fetchByToken(token), refused when absent. The token IS the credential -- the same shape api/sen-portal.js's link token has, and the reason that file's refusals are triaged in preauth_oracle_accepted.json.

api/sairndental/send-reminder.js.reason: Refuses unless the Authorization header equals 'Bearer ' + CRON_SECRET, checked first. Invoked by the vercel.json cron entry.
